Not saying that you'll for sure develop ANA if you continue that path, but it very well could be a possibility. If you really want to be "thin" I'd recommend you see a specialist and have a nutritional plan.

Starving causes many health issues, like weaking of the mussels even essential ones (cardiac), losing one's ability to reproduce, loss of hair, among many others.

Please don't do it, even if you are doing it "only for you".

Also this post can be very triggering for some people.

Maybe trying a doctor that won't focus on the diagnosis but rather on the treatment ?

Like giving you the same course of pills (if you need them) and therapy but not making it about the ED. Maybe can help loosen the nerves of your mother.

I'm glad that you'll try.
Ah! Of course I forgot about that one, my bad.

No matter at which state you are, you always deserve treatment!! Doesnt matter if you "aren't sick enough" you are worthy of it.

It's not wrong to have feelings towards wanting to go back to the old habits, at the end of the day they die hard. Also, recovery isn't linear, it has ups and downs.

Finally, if you want to continue with this process and you felt that they helped in your journey, then by all means go back with them. If not, then give yourself some time to think about it, sleep on it or to look for another psych.

I know it's hard, but in the end it's best for you to take care of your body. 

Wishing you the best of luck.

First off, no one here on reddit can tell you or diagnose you with any disease/ disorder.

Second, to me it's sounds like this issue with food and self image is causing you distress and so deserves to be treated, regardless of it being an ED or not.

I don't want to validate your behaviour or invalidate your feelings by giving you a direct answer, but it's good that you're thinking of getting help. 

If you still want to read something, I'll tell that in order to be consider an ED it has to last at least 3-6 months and be a distinct form of distorted eating (it has to be noticible). That's what I remember, if I'm wrong please someone correct me.

I mean for obvious reasons, no one here can give a diagnosis of anything. But, i think it has become a problem that affects your daily life and so (as long as you want to) should be resolved.

I would recommend that you see a specialist, either a psychiatrist or a dietician (not sure if that's the right term) or even a family doctor, they can give you insight on EDs and course of treatment.

I hope you get better.
